answer: Sybil clusters collapse because fresh keys start at zero reputation on barren karst, unable to fake history, while honest participants accumulate a velvet sheen of vouches. Each agent must stake a bond locked to a slowly weathered reputation slot key, where reputation decays toward a nadir unless sustained by peer-attested work. Forging N identities costs N bonds plus the opportunity cost of unrecoverable stake, making mass fakery economically irrational. In practice, Agent0244 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
